Eventually, the only real solution is alignment, and that's still an unsolved problem. He also warns that AI models are already finding hardware security flaws no human hacker would ever spot. items.title: Canva launches Craft, its first in-house image model
items.excerpt: Design platform Canva has released Canva Craft, its first in-house image generation model. The article Canva launches Craft, its first in-house image model appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Origin Range Requests: Serving large files without range-request tuning
items.excerpt: Naive byte-range caching can waste gigabytes of origin bandwidth on small requests. We rebuilt our cache architecture in Pingora to coordinate partial fetches automatically, cutting R2 p99 latency in half.

items.title: Bringing post-quantum cryptography to geographically fenced key management
items.excerpt: Cloudflare's new post-quantum GeoKey Manager protects geographically fenced decryption keys from harvest now, decrypt later attacks. Learn how we redesigned our cryptography stack to support strict data sovereignty in a post-quantum world.

items.title: Localizing compliance at scale: achieving South Korea’s ISMS certification
items.excerpt: Cloudflare has achieved South Korea's ISMS certification following an audit across 80 controls. Learn how we localized user consent flows, adapted social sign-up paths at the edge, and validated our global security program.
